name: Unified English Answer-Set Consistency Benchmark
description: Unified English benchmark file created by merging the LC-QuAD, QAWiki, SPINACH, and synthetic subsets into one TSV. The unified release contains 600 benchmark items with columns index, source_id, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, and source. It is intended for evaluating answer-set consistency across semantically related question variants while preserving the origin of each item.
citeAs: Anonymous. Unified English Answer-Set Consistency Benchmark. Version 1.0.0. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track submission.

rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of large language models for consistency across semantically related question variants using one merged benchmark file.
Analysis of answer-set equivalence, containment, and decomposition behavior while preserving the source subset of each item.
Not recommended as a standalone training corpus for open-domain QA because it is a small, evaluation-oriented benchmark.
rai:dataBiases: Coverage inherits biases from the underlying LC-QuAD, QAWiki, SPARQL-derived, and synthetic source subsets.
The English-only release may favor models and prompting strategies optimized for English.
Synthetic items may be cleaner and more regular than naturally occurring user queries.
rai:dataLimitations: This unified file is designed for consistency analysis rather than comprehensive factual QA evaluation.
Some intended semantic relations remain approximate because natural-language questions can be pragmatically ambiguous.
The benchmark should not be used to make claims about demographic fairness because it lacks the necessary coverage and annotations.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The released file contains benchmark questions only and is not intended to include personal or sensitive user data.
rai:dataSocialImpact: A positive use of this dataset is improving the reliability of QA systems by testing whether they behave consistently under semantically related prompts. A negative use would be over-claiming that success on this benchmark implies general truthfulness, safety, or fairness.
